# Arcus Wear

> Streetwear brand. Hoodies, tees, sweatpants, and limited-run sets.

## Shop

- [All products](https://www.arcuswear.store/products)
- [Lookbook](https://www.arcuswear.store/lookbook)

## Agent

- endpoint: https://www.arcuswear.store/api/mcp
- protocol: mcp
- name: Arcus Wear
- description: Shop hoodies, tees, sweatpants and sets — browse, add to cart, get shipping quotes, and check out.
- capabilities: list_products, get_product, search_products, get_cart, add_to_cart, get_shipping_quote, create_checkout
- auth: none
- version: 0.2.0
- regions: US
- languages: en
- manifest: https://www.arcuswear.store/.well-known/mcp.json
